traversability.message: Каталожні контури кратерів обійдено. Між клітинками перевіряються перетини, а не лише висоти. Невідомі уступи, дрібні кратери та ґрунт потребують детальнішої перевірки.

hazard_policy.catalogue: Robbins & Hynek Mars crater catalogue, 2014 release
hazard_policy.rule: Do not cross catalogue crater footprints; start/end inside require a locally verified exit.
hazard_policy.limitations: Circle fits are not exact rim polygons or proof of physical impassability. Missing craters and cliffs remain unknown.

warnings: Approximate global route, not a local traversability assessment.
Search is exact in the selected corridor; coarse guidance does not guarantee global optimality.
Absolute elevation is not an obstacle; constraints apply to gradient, not altitude.
Optical imagery and coarse geology are context, not measured rock/soil traction or hazard masks.
Native 0.0625-degree MOLA bins may contain official interpolation.
Distance excludes endpoint snapping offsets; heights are relative to the MOLA areoid.
